summary: Frontend test of ERP-wide duplicate prevention as Super Admin. PASS: sidebar 'Blocked Duplicates' item (inside Management & Admin, has to be expanded) opens /app/admin/duplicate-blocks, page loads with 4 KPI tiles, filters and table, and the 'attempts blocked' count matches the rows. PASS: a new enquiry saved (ENQ-2026-0134 + auto-quote QTN-2026-0117). Double-clicking Save sent only 1 POST and created only 1 record (checked in the DB). PASS: a second enquiry for the same client/site with the same scope got HTTP 409, the warning toast 'Duplicate detected — not saved … already registered as ENQ-2026-0134' appeared, the dialog stayed open and no second row was created. PASS: after the attempts, the admin page showed both of them (business_key with Super Admin / enquiries / ENQ-2026-0134 / timestamp, and rapid_resubmit) and the KPIs went from 0 to 2/2/1/1. FOUND 3 issues: (1) the type/module filters on the admin page are ignored by the backend; (2) when an identical enquiry is resubmitted within 60s, the user sees a misleading 'Enquiry created' success toast; (3) rapid_resubmit rows show the email instead of the user name. Backend pytest was not re-run (frontend only was requested).

minor.issue: The kind and module query params are ignored. list_blocks always passes base query {} to maybe_paged. Choosing 'Duplicate record' (kind=business_key) still returned both rows, including the rapid_resubmit one. The dup-filter-kind and dup-filter-module filters on the UI have no effect (only free-text search works).

Sets name = payload email, so rapid_resubmit rows show 'admin@erp.com' in the User column while business_key rows show 'Super Admin'. They should show the same display name. Also, existing_no is always null for replays; it could store the original record no from the cached response body (e.g. enquiry_no).

integration_issues.flow: Identical enquiry resubmitted within the 60s window
integration_issues.issue: The middleware replays the original 200 (header X-Duplicate-Submission: replayed). The Enquiries page then shows a green 'Enquiry ENQ-xxxx created' toast and closes the dialog, so the user thinks a second record was created. No duplicate is created, but the requirement asks for a clear warning. Fix: in the api.js response interceptor (success path), if headers['x-duplicate-submission']==='replayed', show toast.warning('Duplicate detected — not saved', 'Already submitted as <no>'). The page can also skip its success toast.
Only 1 network call and 1 record (correct), but the success toast appears twice because create() runs twice and shares the in-flight promise. Cosmetic; disable the Save button while saving.

issues: Two toasts stack for one 409: a red toast.error from Enquiries.jsx create() catch, plus the global amber 'Duplicate detected — not saved' warning. Skip the page-level error when err.response.data.duplicate is true.

action_items: duplicate_audit_router.list_blocks: build the base query from the request params kind and module (e.g. module as a case-insensitive regex) and pass it to maybe_paged and the fallback find
api.js: on a successful response with header X-Duplicate-Submission=replayed, show the 'Duplicate detected — not saved' warning instead of letting pages show a 'created' success toast
dedupe._token_user: resolve the display name (or store full_name in the JWT), so rapid_resubmit rows show 'Super Admin', not the email
Enquiries.jsx (and other create forms): add a saving/disabled state on Save, and skip the page toast.error when the 409 has duplicate:true (the global toast already covers it)
critical_code_review_comments: list_blocks ignores the filter params that the UI sends (kind, module)
Replayed responses look like normal successes to the UI, so there is no user-facing warning for the most common double-submit case after the first response returns
The adapter-level in-flight dedupe key uses url+body only. Two different forms posting an identical body to the same url at the same time would share one response; acceptable but worth knowing

success_rate.frontend: 85% (4/4 requested flows pass; 3 minor issues found: filters, replay UX, user name)

seed_data_creation: Created ENQ-2026-0134 (scope 'TEST_DUP scope iter206 …') + auto-quote QTN-2026-0117 + 2 duplicate_blocks rows. ALL deleted after the test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login uses data-testid login-email/login-password/login-submit. The nav item nav-admin-duplicate-blocks is only in the DOM after you expand 'Management & Admin' in the sidebar. The enquiry form needs enq-client-id, enq-site-id (select options), enq-rfq-opt-service and the enq-scope textarea. An identical body within 60s is replayed, so change any field (e.g. enq-priority) to hit the business-rule 409. The enquiries list shows 50 rows per page, so count records in the DB, not by rows on screen.
rca of the issue: Filter bug: duplicate_audit_router.list_blocks calls maybe_paged(request, 'duplicate_blocks', {}, ...) with an empty base query and never reads the kind/module query params. Replay UX: DuplicateSubmissionMiddleware._replay returns the cached 200 body, and the frontend has no handler for the X-Duplicate-Submission: replayed header, so the page's normal success path runs.
